sent_bad: **Qualifying individual (the child being cared for):** Your 11-year-old daughter would qualify, since a qualifying individual includes "Your dependent qualifying child who was under age 13 when the care was provided" (doc.txt).

So, per the document: if the 16-year-old is a dependent you or your spouse may claim, paying her would not make the expenses eligible for the credit; and even if she were an eligible provider, the credit still requires the care to enable you or your spouse to work or look for work, and is limited by your earned income.
